Results.ReviewText:
We've been using Weber Grills for many years. We like this grill, especially the "horizontal" front to back burners. It's perfect for the two of us with the need to cook for company and family when they visit.  The horizontal burners make it much easier to arrange food such as cooking meat with hotter temperatures and vegetables with lower heat...all together. I cooked 30 chicken wings and 8 corn on the cobs easily at the same time.   

One noticeable difference from our previous Weber is this grills hood and the base is much lighter in construction, weight and feel. Another difference is the warm up time.  I could always count on our past grill reaching 600 degrees within 6 minutes.  The new model requires at least 8 to 10 minutes to reach the 600 mark if not longer.
Results.Title: Fourth Weber in 30 years!
